`interface IBridge`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`IAudioBridge`](/reference/bridges/iaudiobridge/), [`IClockBridge`](/reference/bridges/iclockbridge/), [`IRenderBridge`](/reference/bridges/irenderbridge/), [`ISignalReplayBridge`](/reference/bridges/isignalreplaybridge/), [`IThreadBridge`](/reference/bridges/ithreadbridge/), [`IUIBridge`](/reference/backends/iuibridge/), [`IWindowBridge`](/reference/backends/iwindowbridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/IBridge.java)

The marker interface of every bridge, the type that a `BridgeRegistry` holds.

## Description

Every bridge contract extends `IBridge`: UI, window, render, audio, thread, clock and signal replay.
It declares no method.
